sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐形节目。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We have a little different episode for you today, but we have two stories.
sentences.zh: 今天我们为你准备了一期稍有不同的小节，但我们有两个故事。

sentences.en: The first is an update to the Purple Hotel story that was episode number 58 reported by Gwen Maxey.
sentences.zh: 第一个是由格温·麦克西报道的第58期关于“紫色酒店”故事的更新。

sentences.en: There have been some significant changes since we reported that story, so we wanted to update you on that.
sentences.zh: 自从我们报道那个故事以来，已经发生了一些重大变化，所以我们想向你们做个更新。

sentences.en: But first, I have a short story that I performed live on the radio on KLW in San Francisco very, very early in the morning,
sentences.zh: 但首先，我有一个很短的故事，是我很久很久以前的清晨在旧金山KLW电台现场直播的，

sentences.en: but I've never released it as a podcast, so I thought I'd share that one with you today.
sentences.zh: 但我从未将其作为播客发布，所以我想今天把它分享给你们。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Ullman Brown Stroger was an undertaker of all things.
sentences.zh: 阿尔曼·布朗·斯特罗格曾是个包办一切的殡葬商。

sentences.en: Kansas City, Missouri got its first telephone exchange in 1878.
sentences.zh: 密苏里州堪萨斯城于1878年建立了自己的第一个电话交换所。

sentences.en: Telephone service is good for local business, and the funeral business is no exception.
sentences.zh: 电话服务对当地生意大有裨益，殡葬业也不例外。

sentences.en: But at some point, Ullman Brown Stroger of Kansas City noticed that he wasn't getting as many calls from potential customers.
sentences.zh: 但在某个时候，堪萨斯城的阿尔曼·布朗·斯特罗格注意到，他接到的潜在客户电话越来越少了。

sentences.en: He got really suspicious when a friend of the family died, and he wasn't even called about performing the funeral services.
sentences.zh: 当一个家族朋友去世，而他甚至没有接到承办葬礼服务的电话时，他开始感到非常怀疑。

sentences.en: The story goes, and the story is really hard to verify, but I'm going to go with it because I really like it.
sentences.zh: 坊间传闻是这样的，而且这个故事很难核实，但我打算讲它，因为我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: The story goes that after some poking around, Stroger discovered that the wife of a rival undertaker in the area
sentences.zh: 传闻称，在一番打探之后，斯特罗格发现当地一家竞争对手殡葬商的妻子

sentences.en: was an operator for the local telephone company.
sentences.zh: 是当地电话公司的接线员。

sentences.en: At the time, telephones were connected manually by female operators patching lines together on a gigantic punch board.
sentences.zh: 当时，电话是通过女性接线员在一块巨大的插线板上手工插线连接的。

sentences.en: Someone would pick up the receiver, asking for the local undertaker in general, or even Stroger in particular,
sentences.zh: 有人会拿起听筒，询问当地的普通殡葬商，甚至具体点名斯特罗格，

sentences.en: and in this case, the unscrupulous operator would only connect the call to her husband's undertaking business,
sentences.zh: 而在这个案例中，这个不道德的接线员只会把电话接通到她丈夫的殡葬生意，

sentences.en: not to Stroger's.
sentences.zh: 而不是斯特罗格的。

sentences.en: And Stroger figured it out.
sentences.zh: 然后斯特罗格发现了这一点。

sentences.en: If you are Almond Brown Stroger, Kansas City undertaker, there are a few ways you can go when you discover something like this.
sentences.zh: 如果你是堪萨斯城殡葬商阿尔曼·布朗·斯特罗格，当你发现这样的事情时，你有几种处理方式。

sentences.en: Number one.
sentences.zh: 第一种。

sentences.en: And it's number one for a reason, because it makes the most sense.
sentences.zh: 它排在第一位是有原因的，因为它最合情合理。

sentences.en: You can contact the local telephone company and alert them about the dishonest operator and their employee.
sentences.zh: 你可以联系当地电话公司，向他们举报这个不诚实的接线员和他们的员工。

sentences.en: Maybe even get her fired.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能让她被解雇。

sentences.en: Number two.
sentences.zh: 第二种。

sentences.en: You can take her and her husband to civil court.
sentences.zh: 你可以把她和她丈夫告上民事法庭。

sentences.en: Try to sue for damages or something.
sentences.zh: 试图索赔或搞点别的。

sentences.en: Or there's always option number three.
sentences.zh: 或者永远还有第三种选择。

sentences.en: You can invent an automatic telephone switching system that allows people to dial each other directly,
sentences.zh: 你可以发明一种自动电话交换系统，允许人们直接互拨电话，

sentences.en: eliminating any need for a telephone switchboard operator and thereby completely revolutionizing the entire telephone system forever.
sentences.zh: 从而完全不需要电话交换台接线员，并以此彻底永远地革新整个电话系统。

sentences.en: Almond Brown Stroger, the undertaker, went with option number three.
sentences.zh: 殡葬商阿尔曼·布朗·斯特罗格选择了第三种方案。

sentences.en: He wasn't the first to come up with the idea,
sentences.zh: 他并不是第一个想出这个点子的人，

sentences.en: but his concept was the first automatic switcher that worked for more than a handful of phones within a system.
sentences.zh: 但他的概念是第一个能够在一个系统内为不止少数几部电话服务的自动交换机。

sentences.en: He was awarded a patent in 1891.
sentences.zh: 他在1891年被授予了专利。

sentences.en: Of course, he didn't know how to make the thing.
sentences.zh: 当然，他并不知道怎么制造这玩意儿。

sentences.en: He was an undertaker, if I haven't stressed that enough already.
sentences.zh: 如果我还没强调够的话，他是个殡葬商。

sentences.en: Stroger conscripted his nephew and some business partners to help develop a working prototype.
sentences.zh: 斯特罗格拉上了他的侄子和一些商业伙伴来帮忙开发一个能运作的原型机。

sentences.en: It cost more and took longer than anyone anticipated, but they finally got it working.
sentences.zh: 它花费的资金比任何人预计的都多，时间也更长，但他们最终让它运转起来了。

sentences.en: And they finally got a chance to try it out in the real world.
sentences.zh: 他们终于有机会在现实世界中试用它了。

sentences.en: La Porte, Indiana, became the first place to have automatic, operator-free telephone dialing.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳州的拉波特成为了第一个拥有自动、无需接线员拨打电话的地方。

sentences.en: In a speech at the unveiling of the La Porte telephone exchange,
sentences.zh: 在拉波特电话交换所落成典礼的演讲中，

sentences.en: the cantankerous Stroger addressed the issue of the hello girls,
sentences.zh: 脾气暴躁的斯特罗格谈到了“电话姑娘”的问题，

sentences.en: the operators who would lose their jobs because of his automated switch.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些会因为他的自动交换机而失去工作的接线员。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: “引述：

sentences.en: I am often told that the telephone girls will be angry with me for robbing them of their occupation.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到有人说，电话姑娘会因为我抢了她们的饭碗而生我的气。

sentences.en: In reply, I say that all things will adjust themselves to the new order.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，我说一切都会适应新秩序。

sentences.en: Water will find its level.
sentences.zh: 水会找到它自己的水平面。

sentences.en: The telephone replaced the messenger boy as this machine now displaces the telephone girl.
sentences.zh: 电话取代了送信男孩，正如这台机器现在取代了电话姑娘。

sentences.en: Improvements will continue to the end of time.
sentences.zh: 改进将永无止境地持续下去。

sentences.en: Strike where they may.
sentences.zh: 任凭它们何去何从。”

sentences.en: The Bell Telephone Company eventually acquired the technology in 1916.
sentences.zh: 贝尔电话公司最终于1916年收购了这项技术。

sentences.en: And the Stroger switch, as it was called, became standard equipment throughout the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 而所谓的“斯特罗格交换机”成为了整个20世纪的标准设备。

sentences.en: So up next, I'm going to play you episode number 58 again.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我将再次为您播放第58期节目。

sentences.en: It's called Purple Rain about the Purple Hotel, reported by Gwen Max and I.
sentences.zh: 它叫《紫雨》，讲的是紫色酒店，由格温·麦克斯和我报道。

sentences.en: And then we're going to have a really, really significant, you know, like four or five minute update
sentences.zh: 然后我们将有一个非常非常重要的，你知道的，大概四五分钟的更新，

sentences.en: about what happened to the Purple Hotel since this was first reported.
sentences.zh: 讲述自首次报道以来紫色酒店发生了什么。

sentences.en: So stay tuned for that.
sentences.zh: 所以请继续收听。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐形节目。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The hotel on the very prominent corner of Tui and Kilburn Avenue in Lincolnwood, Illinois,
sentences.zh: 位于伊利诺伊州林肯伍德图伊大街和基尔本大街交汇处显眼街角的这家酒店，

sentences.en: used to be the town's most famous building.
sentences.zh: 曾是该镇最著名的建筑。

sentences.en: The first Hyatt Hotel in all of Chicagoland.
sentences.zh: 整个芝加哥地区的第一家凯悦酒店。

sentences.en: Premier accommodations.
sentences.zh: 一流的住宿。

sentences.en: Top-notch restaurant.
sentences.zh: 顶级的餐厅。

sentences.en: It was swank.
sentences.zh: 它时髦极了。

sentences.en: Roberta Flack stayed there.
sentences.zh: 罗伯塔·弗拉克曾下榻于此。

sentences.en: Barry Manilow stayed there.
sentences.zh: 巴里·曼尼洛曾下榻于此。

sentences.en: Perry Como.
sentences.zh: 佩里·科莫。

sentences.en: Michael Jordan stayed there on his first night in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·乔丹在芝加哥的第一晚就住在这里。

sentences.en: And every 13-year-old boy in the area had his bar mitzvah there.
sentences.zh: 当地的每一个13岁男孩都在那里举行成人礼。

sentences.en: The hotel was built in 1960, and it looks it.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店建于1960年，看起来也确实如此。

sentences.en: So if you're wondering how much potentially anachronistic lounge music I'm going to cram into this episode,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在想我会在这一期里塞进多少可能过时的休息室音乐，

sentences.en: oh, it's going to be a lot.
sentences.zh: 哦，那可有得受了。

sentences.en: Then, slowly, over time, it became Lincolnwood's most infamous building.
sentences.zh: 然后，随着时间的推移，它慢慢成了林肯伍德最声名狼藉的建筑。

sentences.en: It changed hands, got seedy, and run down.
sentences.zh: 它几经转手，变得藏污纳垢、破败不堪。

sentences.en: It was the home of the Midwest Fetish Fair and Marketplace Convention.
sentences.zh: 这里曾是中西部恋物癖展销会和集市大会的举办地。

sentences.en: There were drug-fueled sex parties attended by shady Chicago politicians later convicted of things like extortion.
sentences.zh: 那里举行过毒品泛滥的性派对，参加者包括后来因敲诈勒索等罪名被定罪的芝加哥黑幕政客。

sentences.en: And, of course, there was the convicted mobster Alan Dorfman, who was gunned down in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有被定罪的黑手党分子阿伦·多尔夫曼，他在停车场被枪杀。

sentences.en: But that's not why everyone in the area knows the building.
sentences.zh: 但当地人知道这座建筑并不是因为这个。

sentences.en: If you know nothing of its history, it's still pretty hard to miss.
sentences.zh: 如果你对它的历史一无所知，它依然很难被忽视。

sentences.en: Because it's purple.
sentences.zh: 因为它甚至是紫色的。

sentences.en: Really, really purple.
sentences.zh: 真的，非常紫。

sentences.en: Growing up nearby, I always thought it was really, really ugly.
sentences.zh: 在附近长大的我，一直觉得它真的非常非常丑。

sentences.en: Lots of people did.
sentences.zh: 很多人也这么认为。

sentences.en: To be fair, lots of people didn't.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，也有很多人不这么认为。

sentences.en: But everyone had an opinion about it.
sentences.zh: 但每个人对它都有看法。

sentences.en: But Gwen Maxey, that's who I'm talking to now, by the way,
sentences.zh: 不过格温·麦克西——顺便说一下，这就是我现在正在交谈的人，

sentences.en: noted essayist and public radio host, and she even created a sitcom once.
sentences.zh: 知名散文家和公共广播主持人，她甚至还创作过一部情景喜剧。

sentences.en: She has a secret about the Purple Hotel.
sentences.zh: 她对紫色酒店有一个秘密。

sentences.en: Well, my father designed it.
sentences.zh: “嗯，我父亲设计的。”

sentences.en: My name is John Maxey.
sentences.zh: “我叫约翰·麦克西。

sentences.en: I'm a retired architect and former professor at UIC.
sentences.zh: 我是伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的退休建筑师兼前教授。

sentences.en: I designed a lot of...
sentences.zh: 我设计了许多……”

sentences.en: Just the building we're talking about.
sentences.zh: “我们就谈谈我们正在讨论的那栋建筑。

sentences.en: Don't interrupt.
sentences.zh: 别打断。”

sentences.en: I don't have time for the long bio, Dad.
sentences.zh: “我没有时间听长篇大论的履历，爸爸。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I designed a lot of apartment buildings in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我在芝加哥设计了许多公寓楼。

sentences.en: We're here to talk about the Purple Hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们是来谈论紫色酒店的。

sentences.en: I need you to say, I design...
sentences.zh: 我需要你说，我设计……

sentences.en: My name is John Maxey.
sentences.zh: 我叫约翰·麦克西。

sentences.en: I'm an architect.
sentences.zh: 我是一名建筑师。

sentences.en: I designed the Purple Hotel.
sentences.zh: 我设计了紫色酒店。”

sentences.en: My name is John Maxey.
sentences.zh: 我叫约翰·麦克西。

sentences.en: I'm an architect.
sentences.zh: 我是一名建筑师。

sentences.en: And I was the designer of the Purple Hotel.
sentences.zh: 我是紫色酒店的设计师。

sentences.en: Finally.
sentences.zh: 终于。

sentences.en: Now, you have to understand that when I say the building is purple,
sentences.zh: 现在，你必须明白，当我建造这栋建筑是紫色的时候，

sentences.en: I don't mean the kind of purple of, say, an iris or a plum.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种鸢尾花或李子般的紫色。

sentences.en: It's purple as in lavender.
sentences.zh: 它是那种薰衣草般的紫。

sentences.en: Lavender purple glazed brick all over pretty much the entire thing.
sentences.zh: 几乎整栋建筑都贴满了薰衣草紫的釉面砖。

sentences.en: Which, needless to say, makes it stand out.
sentences.zh: 不用说，这让它格外显眼。

sentences.en: Depending on how you look at it, like a prized jewel or a sore thumb.
sentences.zh: 取决于你看它的角度，它看起来像一颗珍贵的宝石，或者像眼中钉。

sentences.en: You know, that's one of the few buildings that if you see it once, you know, you've seen it forever.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是少数几栋你看过一次，就会永远记住的建筑。

sentences.en: You can't, you know, get the image out of your mind.
sentences.zh: 你无法将这个形象从脑海中抹去。

sentences.en: It is so purple that after it changed hands, the new owners renamed it The Purple Hotel.
sentences.zh: 它是如此之紫，以至于易主后，新主人将其更名为“紫色酒店”。

sentences.en: WBEZ architecture critic, Lee Bay.
sentences.zh: WBEZ建筑评论员李·贝。

sentences.en: I think that it's worth looking at, absent the brick, the brick I like.
sentences.zh: 我认为抛开砖块不谈，它也值得一看，我挺喜欢这些砖的。

sentences.en: But I wish you could, you know, sort of put on the glasses that can filter it out so you don't see the brick,
sentences.zh: 但我希望你能戴上那种能把它过滤掉的眼镜，这样你就看不到砖块了，

sentences.en: at least in one trip, and really see how the building holds itself together structurally.
sentences.zh: 至少在一次参观中，真正看看这座建筑在结构上是如何组合在一起的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's really good.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为它真的很棒。

sentences.en: The way that John was able to put those supports on the outside of the hotel to give larger floor plates in the middle,
sentences.zh: 约翰能够将这些支撑结构放在酒店外部，从而在中间提供更大的楼层平面图，

sentences.en: which is what you want.
sentences.zh: 这就是你想要的。

sentences.en: You want big functional spaces instead of a hotel.
sentences.zh: 你想要的是大型功能空间，而不是传统的酒店。

sentences.en: And then, again, the little nooks of green space and the way the sort of the buildings kind of fit together,
sentences.zh: 然后，还有那些微小的绿地角落，以及建筑物相互契合的方式，

sentences.en: the complex fits together.
sentences.zh: 整个综合体相互契合的方式。

sentences.en: I mean, really, there's really a lot of good things going on there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的，那里确实有很多很好的设计。

sentences.en: You know, I say, come for the purple, but stay for the architecture.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我说过，为紫色而来，因建筑而留。

sentences.en: The thing that everybody notices first, including architects, would be the color.
sentences.zh: 每个人首先注意到的东西，包括建筑师在内，就是它的颜色。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that if anybody's saying that it's not the color, that they're lying,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果有人说不是因为颜色，那他们就是在撒谎，

sentences.en: because you can't really look at the building without noticing that it's purple.
sentences.zh: 因为你看着这座建筑，不可能不注意到它是紫色的。

sentences.en: So it's the only purple building around.
sentences.zh: 所以它是周围唯一的紫色建筑。

sentences.en: But then, you know, after that initial wave of color hits you,
sentences.zh: 但是随后，在最初的色彩冲击波袭击你之后，

sentences.en: you notice really what a great modernist structure it has
sentences.zh: 你会真正注意到它是一座多么伟大的现代主义结构，

sentences.en: and how the structure is expressed on the outside,
sentences.zh: 以及这种结构是如何在外部表现出来的，

sentences.en: which is also not something you see every day anymore.
sentences.zh: 这也是现在不常见到的景象。

sentences.en: And I think it's a wonderful building.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一座极好的建筑。

sentences.en: That was Jackie Koo, founding principal of the architectural firm Koo & Associates.
sentences.zh: 那是杰基·库，建筑事务所库与合伙公司的创始合伙人。

sentences.en: We'll get back to her in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们一会儿再回来找她。

sentences.en: But first, the story of why and how the building got to be so purple.
sentences.zh: 但首先，讲讲这座建筑为什么以及如何变得如此之紫的故事。

sentences.en: My dad, John Maxei.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸，约翰·麦克西。

sentences.en: It was commissioned by the Pritzkers, a very rich family in Chicago,
sentences.zh: 它是芝加哥一个非常富有的家族——普利茨克家族委托建造的，

sentences.en: and it was the first Hyatt Hotel in the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 这是中西部第一家凯悦酒店。

sentences.en: It was called Hyatt House.
sentences.zh: 它当时叫凯悦之屋。

sentences.en: It had nothing to do with the purple.
sentences.zh: 这跟紫色没有任何关系。

sentences.en: By the way, the purple came because one of the Pritzkers, A.N.,
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，紫色的出现是因为普利茨克家族的一员A.N.，

sentences.en: the big man among the Pritzkers in the family,
sentences.zh: 普利茨克家族里的领军人物，

sentences.en: asked me what color clay style I want to use.
sentences.zh: 问我想用什么颜色的粘土风格。

sentences.en: And I wanted to use gray.
sentences.zh: 而我想用灰色。

sentences.en: And he said, that's dull.
sentences.zh: 他说，那太沉闷了。

sentences.en: I'd like something brighter.
sentences.zh: 我想要更亮丽一点的颜色。

sentences.en: So I made the mistake of showing him the samples of books,
sentences.zh: 所以我犯了个错误，拿了书本的样品给他看，

sentences.en: having only some 35, 40 colored samples.
sentences.zh: 当时只有大约35、40种颜色的样品。

sentences.en: And sure enough, he picked the purple.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，他挑了紫色。

sentences.en: And you don't argue with A.N.
sentences.zh: 而且你可不能跟A.N.

sentences.en: Pritzker.
sentences.zh: 普里茨克争辩。

sentences.en: My father tells me this story, but I suspect differently.
sentences.zh: 我父亲跟我讲了这个故事，但我觉得另有隐情。

sentences.en: He's always gravitated toward bold color choices.
sentences.zh: 他总是偏爱大胆的色彩。

sentences.en: Our current argument is over bright orange balconies on a building that we always pass.
sentences.zh: 我们最近争论的是一件我们经常路过的建筑上亮橘色的阳台。

sentences.en: He loves them, and I hate them.
sentences.zh: 他很喜欢，但我讨厌。

sentences.en: When I was growing up, his favorite color was blue,
sentences.zh: 在我成长过程中，他最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，

sentences.en: a color that to me is suspiciously close to purple.
sentences.zh: 这个颜色在我看来跟紫色可疑地接近。

sentences.en: In fact, every house we ever lived in,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们住过的每一栋房子，

sentences.en: brick bungalow, summer house in the woods,
sentences.zh: 砖砌平房、树林里的避暑别墅、

sentences.en: suburban barn-shaped house with mustard-colored siding,
sentences.zh: 郊区带有芥末色壁板的谷仓式房屋，

sentences.en: all had bright blue front doors that my father painted.
sentences.zh: 都有我父亲刷的亮蓝色前门。

sentences.en: My elementary school bus driver used to call me Blue Door.
sentences.zh: 我小学的校车司机以前管我叫“蓝门”。

sentences.en: Upon interrogation, my father coughed up his strange Hungarian logic.
sentences.zh: 经过一番盘问，我父亲吐露了他那奇怪的匈牙利逻辑。

sentences.en: In the Near East, where ultimately I come from,
sentences.zh: 在中东，也就是我的最终根源所在地，

sentences.en: the blue color on the doors, blue and green,
sentences.zh: 门上的蓝色，蓝色和绿色，

sentences.en: is to keep the evil spirit away.
sentences.zh: 是为了驱除恶灵。

sentences.en: So that's the reason I always painted the entrance door of our houses blue,
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我为什么总是把我们房子的入户门漆成蓝色，

sentences.en: to keep the evil spirit away.
sentences.zh: 为了驱除恶灵。

sentences.en: And it did.
sentences.zh: 而且确实管用了。

sentences.en: Do you think it worked for the hotel?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这招对酒店也管用吗？

sentences.en: The blue was pranked.
sentences.zh: 那蓝色被人恶作剧了。

sentences.en: So you don't think the purple kept away the evil eye from the hotel?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为紫色并没有帮酒店挡住厄运？

sentences.en: Not really, because there was a murder in the hotel.
sentences.zh: 不见得，因为酒店里发生过谋杀案。

sentences.en: Actually, there were two, but I digress.
sentences.zh: 其实发生过两起，不过我扯远了。

sentences.en: The beauty of that building is the exposed concrete frame,
sentences.zh: 那栋建筑的美妙之处在于外露的混凝土框架，

sentences.en: how the columns are pulled out of the structure,
sentences.zh: 柱子是如何从结构中凸显出来的，

sentences.en: showing this.
sentences.zh: 展示了这一点。

sentences.en: It's like a human being whose skeleton will be on the exterior, partially.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个人，其骨架部分暴露在外面。

sentences.en: That would be weird, right?
sentences.zh: 那会很诡异，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, that's the way that building is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那栋建筑就是那样的。

sentences.en: The columns are pulled out.
sentences.zh: 柱子是凸出来的。

sentences.en: The slabs are slightly pulled out.
sentences.zh: 楼板也稍微凸出来一点。

sentences.en: It's a building which reveals its structure.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋展现其结构的建筑。

sentences.en: And that is, architecturally, the interesting thing about it.
sentences.zh: 从建筑学上讲，这正是它的有趣之处。

sentences.en: The purple is totally irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 紫色完全无关紧要。

sentences.en: It could be green, okay?
sentences.zh: 它可以是绿色，好吗？

sentences.en: It would be the same good or bad building.
sentences.zh: 它作为一栋建筑的好坏程度都是一样的。

sentences.en: So, as an architect, I have to ask you,
sentences.zh: 所以，作为一名建筑师，我不得不问你，

sentences.en: this is a perfect example of what the difference between what the public sees
sentences.zh: 这完美地体现了公众所看到的

sentences.en: and what the architect sees.
sentences.zh: 与建筑师所看到的之间的区别。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是的。

sentences.en: Because the public sees purple brick,
sentences.zh: 因为公众看到的是紫色的砖，

sentences.en: the architect is sitting here saying,
sentences.zh: 而建筑师坐在这里会说，

sentences.en: the purple is so unimportant in the scheme of the building.
sentences.zh: 在这栋建筑的整体构思中，紫色是如此微不足道。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It means nothing.
sentences.zh: 它什么也不是。

sentences.en: It's just such a tiny thing.
sentences.zh: 它只是个极小的事情。

sentences.en: But to the public, that's all it is.
sentences.zh: 但对公众来说，这就是全部了。

sentences.en: That's right, because the public is ignorant.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为公众是无知的。

sentences.en: Very, truly ignorant.
sentences.zh: 非常、真正的无知。

sentences.en: Well, you can't really argue with him there.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在这点上你确实没法反驳他。

sentences.en: But in our defense, and I count myself as one of the public in this scenario,
sentences.zh: 但为了我们自己辩护——在这个情境下我也把自己归为公众的一员——

sentences.en: it's really, really purple.
sentences.zh: 它是真的很紫很紫。

sentences.en: And despite how far the Purple Hotel fell from its original glory,
sentences.zh: 尽管紫色的酒店从它最初的辉煌中跌落，

sentences.en: the dilapidation, the murder, the drug-fueled sex parties,
sentences.zh: 经历了破败、谋杀、毒品派对，

sentences.en: and a demolition order, it was not torn down.
sentences.zh: 以及拆除令，但它并没有被拆除。

sentences.en: Time passed.
sentences.zh: 时光流逝。

sentences.en: The economy fell to pieces.
sentences.zh: 经济一团糟。

sentences.en: Mid-century architecture slowly came back into vogue.
sentences.zh: 世纪中叶的建筑风格慢慢重新流行起来。

sentences.en: Mad Men was on TV.
sentences.zh: 电视上正播着《广告狂人》。

sentences.en: The purple brick was kind of retro-cool.
sentences.zh: 紫色的砖块带有一种复古酷炫的风格。

sentences.en: A light, however dim, was starting to shine on the building and its future.
sentences.zh: 微弱的光芒，哪怕再微弱，也开始照亮这座建筑及其未来。

sentences.en: Then, the Purple Hotel was nominated for landmark status,
sentences.zh: 然后，紫色酒店被提名具有地标地位，

sentences.en: a place on the historic registry.
sentences.zh: 获得了历史登记处的一席之地。

sentences.en: There was talk of finding a buyer, talk of renovation.
sentences.zh: 有传言说要找买家，有传言说要翻新。

sentences.en: And then, while I was searching and interviewing for this very story,
sentences.zh: 然后，正当我为这个故事进行搜寻和采访时，

sentences.en: the Purple Hotel went up for auction.
sentences.zh: 紫色酒店被拍卖了。

sentences.en: There was a lot of pomp and circumstance in the beginning of, you know,
sentences.zh: 一开始有很多排场和盛况，你知道的，

sentences.en: the auctioneer yelling and saying,
sentences.zh: 拍卖师大喊大叫，

sentences.en: Are you ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, in the booming voice.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，声音洪亮。

sentences.en: And then, really, there was only one bidder.
sentences.zh: 然后，实际上，只有一个竞标者。

sentences.en: And that bidder was Jake Weiss, of Weiss Properties in Skokie,
sentences.zh: 那个竞标者是来自斯科基韦斯地产公司的杰克·维斯，

sentences.en: which happens to be right next to Lincolnwood.
sentences.zh: 而斯科基恰好就在林肯伍德旁边。

sentences.en: He bought the Purple Hotel.
sentences.zh: 他买下了紫色酒店。

sentences.en: And while Weiss is a shrewd businessman with a keen eye and good instincts,
sentences.zh: 虽然维斯是一个精明的商人，有着敏锐的眼光和良好的直觉，

sentences.en: this particular purchase was also a labor of love.
sentences.zh: 但这次特殊的购买也是一项倾注了热爱的工程。

sentences.en: When you have something that really is just not realizing its value and its potential,
sentences.zh: 当你拥有这样一样东西，它没有发挥出它的价值和潜力，

sentences.en: that has such a prime piece of property, it bothers you, you know.
sentences.zh: 又占据着如此黄金的地段，这会让你感到困扰，你知道的。

sentences.en: It's part of your neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 它是你社区的一部分。

sentences.en: It's part of your community.
sentences.zh: 它是你集体的一部分。

sentences.en: And it's something that you really want to see be an asset to the community instead of a blight.
sentences.zh: 这是你真心希望看到它成为社区的财富而不是败笔的东西。

sentences.en: Here comes the love part.
sentences.zh: 充满爱意的地方来了。

sentences.en: Separately from that, when my, and more importantly, I think,
sentences.zh: 抛开这些不谈，当我的——而且我认为更重要的是，

sentences.en: we almost lived at the Purple Hotel for a period of time,
sentences.zh: 我们有一段时间几乎就住在紫色酒店里，

sentences.en: when my grandfather had passed away and my father was saying the traditional kaddish.
sentences.zh: 当时我外祖父去世了，我父亲正在念传统的卡迪什。

sentences.en: That's the Jewish prayer for the dead.
sentences.zh: 那是犹太人悼念死者的祈祷文。

sentences.en: There was no synagogue anywhere in close proximity to where he lived at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时他住的地方附近方圆几里都没有犹太会堂。

sentences.en: And because we're Orthodox and we don't drive on the Sabbath,
sentences.zh: 因为我们是正统派，安息日不能开车，

sentences.en: that was a little bit prohibitive to say the kaddish.
sentences.zh: 这使得念卡迪什变得有点困难。

sentences.en: There's a very convenient shul right down the block.
sentences.zh: 街区尽头就有一个非常方便的犹太教堂。

sentences.en: Also known as a synagogue.
sentences.zh: 也就是犹太会堂。

sentences.en: The congregation Yehuda Moshe.
sentences.zh: 耶胡达·摩西会众。

sentences.en: So on every single Shabbos for a year,
sentences.zh: 所以在整整一年的每一个安息日，

sentences.en: we would move into the Purple Hotel
sentences.zh: 我们都会搬进紫色酒店，

sentences.en: to accommodate my father's responsibility to say the kaddish for his father.
sentences.zh: 以满足我父亲为他父亲念卡迪什的责任。

sentences.en: So we lived there for about a year every single weekend.
sentences.zh: 所以我们每个周末都在那里住了一年左右。

sentences.en: And, you know, me and my sister, the hotel was our playground.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我和我姐姐，那酒店就是我们的游乐场。

sentences.en: And the architect Weiss has chosen to redesign the Purple Hotel
sentences.zh: 而建筑师维斯选择重新设计紫色酒店并恢复其最初的光彩，他就是杰克·库（Jackie Koo）与杰克·库建筑事务所的杰克·库。

sentences.en: and bring it back to its original luster is Jackie Koo of Jackie Koo & Associates.
sentences.zh: 杰克·库（Jackie Koo）：

sentences.en: One of the things that we're looking into is more of a historic restoration of the building.
sentences.zh: 我们正在研究的事情之一是对建筑进行更多历史性的修复。

sentences.en: And it would be wonderful, especially since we have some of the old drawings,
sentences.zh: 这将是美妙的，特别是我们还保留了一些旧图纸，

sentences.en: the original drawings from the 60s.
sentences.zh: 60年代的原始图纸。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of pieces that are still left in the building,
sentences.zh: 建筑里还留下了很多部件，

sentences.en: such as this wonderful, monumental terrazzo stair with this wood wall behind it.
sentences.zh: 比如这个绝妙的、具有纪念意义的水磨石楼梯，后面配着这面木墙。

sentences.en: I mean, you can really see it as this kind of, you know, late 50s, early 60s,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你真的能把它看作是一种，你知道的，50年代末60年代初的，

sentences.en: kind of Mad Men era, Pan Am sort of hotel
sentences.zh: 类似于《广告狂人》时代、泛美航空那种风格的酒店，

sentences.en: that really could be very current in today's hospitality environment.
sentences.zh: 它在当今的酒店业环境中绝对可以非常时髦。

sentences.en: The culture today, especially in the hospitality market,
sentences.zh: 当今的文化，特别是在酒店市场，

sentences.en: for some reason, purple is a predominant color.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，紫色是一种主色调。

sentences.en: Not necessarily in the color of the brick, but in all their marketing.
sentences.zh: 不一定是在砖的颜色上，而是在他们所有的营销中。

sentences.en: I mean, you'll look at the neon lights and the color of the key fob cards
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你会看到霓虹灯、房卡颜色

sentences.en: and the brochures that get printed.
sentences.zh: 以及印出来的宣传册。

sentences.en: For some reason, purple is popping, and I'm not quite sure why.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，紫色很火爆，但我不太确定为什么。

sentences.en: Have any of your buildings had this kind of history,
sentences.zh: 你所知道的你的建筑中，有没有经历过这种历史，

sentences.en: this kind of life cycle that you know of?
sentences.zh: 这种生命周期的？

sentences.en: No, none of them.
sentences.zh: 没有，一个也没有。

sentences.en: The same way that a person may go through life
sentences.zh: 就像一个人可能会经历一生，

sentences.en: and you might go through different cycles yourself
sentences.zh: 你可能自己也会经历不同的周期，

sentences.en: and everybody goes through different rebellious times and ups and downs,
sentences.zh: 每个人都会经历不同的叛逆期和起起落落，

sentences.en: I think the same holds true for a property like this
sentences.zh: 我认为对于这样一个真正具有自身特色的物业来说也是如此，

sentences.en: that really was a character of itself.
sentences.zh: 这是一个本身就很有个性的物业。

sentences.en: The building was really a product of the environment around it at any given time.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑在任何特定时期确实都是它周围环境的产物。

sentences.en: And, you know, to a certain extent,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在某种程度上，

sentences.en: the fact that the building did change with the decades and the environment around it,
sentences.zh: 这座建筑确实随着几十年的时间和周围环境而改变，

sentences.en: it really is the building's character.
sentences.zh: 这确实就是建筑的个性。

sentences.en: And while it's true that this character, this building,
sentences.zh: 虽然这个个性、这座建筑、

sentences.en: this structure of nine lives sits empty at the moment,
sentences.zh: 这座历经九命的结构目前确实空置着，

sentences.en: surrounded by bored traffic and an empty parking lot,
sentences.zh: 周围只有无聊的车流和空旷的停车场，

sentences.en: it may just be crouching, gathering its muster, ready to spring back to life,
sentences.zh: 但它可能只是在蹲伏，积蓄力量，准备重新焕发生机，

sentences.en: arresting that traffic, filling that parking lot,
sentences.zh: 截流那里的车流，填满那个停车场，

sentences.en: and strutting like a proud peacock.
sentences.zh: 像一头骄傲的孔雀一样昂首阔步。

sentences.en: A purple one.
sentences.zh: 一只紫色的。

sentences.en: I'd like to thank Red Mandel from National Wrecking Company
sentences.zh: 我要感谢国家拆除公司的雷德·曼德尔，

sentences.en: for doing all that he and his company could do to make this day a reality.
sentences.zh: 感谢他和他的公司为将这一天变成现实所做的一切努力。

sentences.en: So it turns out that after all of the gargantuan efforts to save the Purple Hotel,
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在为了拯救紫色酒店付出了巨大努力之后，

sentences.en: it would have cost 40-some million dollars.
sentences.zh: 这需要花费四千多万美元。

sentences.en: That's a million with an F.
sentences.zh: 千万（million）的m发音听起来像f。

sentences.en: Actually, it was over 40 million dollars.
sentences.zh: 实际上，超过了四千万美元。

sentences.en: It was just cost prohibitive.
sentences.zh: 成本实在太高了。

sentences.en: So despite so much goodwill on the part of so many people
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管有这么多人怀着满腔善意，

sentences.en: who wanted to see it survive, the Purple Hotel was torn down.
sentences.zh: 希望看到它存活下来，紫色酒店还是被拆除了。

sentences.en: Or I should say, is in the process of being torn down.
sentences.zh: 或者我应该说，正处于被拆除的过程中。

sentences.en: But at least the process of tearing the Purple Hotel down began with some ceremony.
sentences.zh: 但至少，拆除紫楼的过程是以某种仪式开始的。

sentences.en: If everybody can start finding a seat, we're going to get started.
sentences.zh: 如果大家能开始找个座位，我们要开始了。

sentences.en: On August 27, 2013, the parking lot of the Purple Hotel
sentences.zh: 2013年8月27日，紫楼的停车场

sentences.en: was filled with local dignitaries from Lincolnwood, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 挤满了来自伊利诺伊州林肯伍德的当地政要。

sentences.en: Even the mayor was there.
sentences.zh: 连市长也出席了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being here, Mayor.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您的到来，市长。

sentences.en: So on the day of the demolition, it was really, really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 所以，在拆迁的那天，真的很美、真的很美。

sentences.en: They had a huge white tent.
sentences.zh: 他们搭了一个巨大的白帐篷。

sentences.en: They had purple flowers.
sentences.zh: 他们准备了紫色的花朵。

sentences.en: They had purple napkins.
sentences.zh: 他们准备了紫色的餐巾。

sentences.en: They gave my dad a purple brick with a plaque on it.
sentences.zh: 他们送给我父亲一块带铭牌的紫色砖头。

sentences.en: I mean, it was just really, really beautifully done.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的做得非常、非常漂亮。

sentences.en: And it was a loving tribute to the building.
sentences.zh: 这是对这座建筑充满深情的致敬。

sentences.en: At the same time, it was a little bit like going to synagogue
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这有点像去参加犹太会堂的活动

sentences.en: because Lincolnwood is a predominantly Jewish suburb, or at least it was.
sentences.zh: 因为林肯伍德是一个主要由犹太人居住的郊区，或者至少曾经是。

sentences.en: And so all the people who had such strong feelings about the building
sentences.zh: 因此，所有对这座建筑怀有深厚感情的人

sentences.en: largely were Jewish.
sentences.zh: 大部分都是犹太人。

sentences.en: Okay, good morning.
sentences.zh: 好的，大家早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Thank you all for coming to my bar mitzvah today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家今天来参加我的成年礼。

sentences.en: But this wasn't exactly a bar mitzvah.
sentences.zh: 但这并不完全是一场成年礼。

sentences.en: When John Maxi took the stage, he said it was a little more like another rite of passage.
sentences.zh: 当约翰·马克西（John Maxi）走上舞台时，他说这更像是另一种人生考验。

sentences.en: It's a little bit like being invited for your own funeral.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是被邀请参加你自己的葬礼。

sentences.en: Which, by the way, cannot be avoided.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这是无法避免的。

sentences.en: Kind of curious thing that an architect is invited to the tearing down of his building.
sentences.zh: 一个建筑师被邀请去见证自己建筑的拆毁，这真是一件奇妙的事。

sentences.en: The typical moment a piece of architecture and a piece of journalism coincide
sentences.zh: 建筑作品与新闻报道通常交织在一起的时刻

sentences.en: is when the building is first constructed.
sentences.zh: 是在这座建筑最初建造的时候。

sentences.en: This is like writing the biography of a person the moment that he or she is born.
sentences.zh: 这就像是在一个人刚出生时就为他或她写传记。

sentences.en: The real story is how the structure influences the environment,
sentences.zh: 真实的故事是这座建筑如何影响环境，

sentences.en: how it grows up, how its fortune changes, and even how it dies.
sentences.zh: 它如何成长，它的命运如何改变，甚至它是如何消亡的。

sentences.en: Though this wasn't really the end of the Purple Hotel anyway.
sentences.zh: 不过，这其实也并不是紫楼的终点。

sentences.en: The wrecking ball took a couple of whacks at the building, and then they stopped.
sentences.zh: 拆房锤在建筑上砸了几下，然后他们就停下来了。

sentences.en: It's going to take five months to tear it down
sentences.zh: 这将需要五个月的时间才能拆完

sentences.en: because 75% of it needs to be recycled as a matter of law.
sentences.zh: 因为根据法律规定，其中75%的材料需要被回收利用。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Brick by purple brick.
sentences.zh: 一块块紫色的砖。

sentences.en: They're taking it down.
sentences.zh: 它们正在被拆除。

sentences.en: So the bricks would just get thrown into a big pile and shipped off to wherever they get recycled
sentences.zh: 因此，如果不是因为人们对它们有这么高的需求，

sentences.en: if there wasn't such a high demand for them.
sentences.zh: 这些砖头就会被扔进一个大堆里，运往任何回收它们的地方。

sentences.en: It turns out that everybody and their brother wants a purple brick.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，人人都想要一块紫砖。

sentences.en: I was married at that hotel.
sentences.zh: 我在那家酒店结的婚。

sentences.en: I lost my virginity at that hotel.
sentences.zh: 我在那家酒店失去了童贞。

sentences.en: I used to go to that hotel every weekend with my parents.
sentences.zh: 我过去每个周末都和父母一起去那家酒店。

sentences.en: I played in the pool at that hotel.
sentences.zh: 我在那家酒店的泳池里玩耍过。

sentences.en: I heard Roberta Flack at that hotel.
sentences.zh: 我在那家酒店听过罗伯塔·弗莱克的演唱。

sentences.en: I mean, everybody has a memory associated with it,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个人都有一段与它相关的记忆，

sentences.en: and so everybody wants a brick.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都想要一块砖。

sentences.en: And I can't even tell you how many people have asked me for a brick,
sentences.zh: 我甚至无法告诉你有多少人向我要过砖，

sentences.en: not the least of which, I might add, was you.
sentences.zh: 其中当然也少不了你，我得补充一句。

sentences.en: Oh, I want a purple brick so badly.
sentences.zh: 哦，我太想要一块紫色的砖了。

sentences.en: Um, I'm going to get you at least a chip, if not a brick.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我至少会给你弄个碎块，如果不是整块砖的话。

sentences.en: As long as it has some purple on it.
sentences.zh: 只要上面带点紫色就行。

sentences.en: It will have the iconic purple glaze on it.
sentences.zh: 它会带有标志性的紫色釉面。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Gwen Maxey, Sam Greenspan, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由格温·马克西、山姆·格林斯潘和我——罗曼·马尔斯共同制作。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 local public radio KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 本地公共广播电台 KALW

sentences.en: and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 以及旧金山美国建筑师学会的项目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在脸书上找到并点赞这个节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是 Roman Mars。

sentences.en: Sam Greenspan tweets at Sam Listens.
sentences.zh: 山姆·格林斯潘的推特账号是 Sam Listens。

sentences.en: But right now, you can find pictures of the destruction of the Purple Hotel
sentences.zh: 但现在，你可以在 99percentinvisible.org 上找到紫楼被拆除的照片

sentences.en: and also some nice pictures of it in its heyday at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 以及它全盛时期的一些漂亮照片。

sentences.en: The band you're listening to right now is called OK Akumi.
sentences.zh: 你现在听到的这支乐队名叫 OK Akumi。

sentences.en: We use a lot of them on this radio program along with bands like
sentences.zh: 我们在本广播节目中经常使用他们的音乐，还有诸如

sentences.en: Lollatone and Melodium and Orcas.
sentences.zh: Lollatone、Melodium 和 Orcas 等乐队的音乐。

sentences.en: If you want to score your life like an episode of 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 如果你想为你的生活配上像《99%隐形》单集一样的背景音乐，

sentences.en: go to our webpage, it's 99pi.org, and look for our Spotify playliSt.
sentences.zh: 请访问我们的网页 99pi.org，寻找我们的 Spotify 播放列表。

sentences.en: And then, you know, go buy something of theirs because all these bands are awesome.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，去买点他们的作品吧，因为所有这些乐队都太棒了。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
